newsitem.title: JAPAN: Sega president and others to buy Lease Elec shares.
newsitem.headline: Sega president and others to buy Lease Elec shares.

text.p: Lease Electronics Co Ltd said on Tuesday that the president of Sega Enterprises Ltd, Hayao Nakayama, and other parties are planning to buy about two million shares, or 41.51 percent, in Lease Electronics.
The buyers also include ADO Electronic Industrial Co Ltd and its president, Lease Electronics said in a statement.
They will buy two million shares at 430 yen per share from Wednesday until Tuesday next week, Lease Electronics said.

Lease Electronics is a wholesaler of personal computer and peripheral equipment. ADO, which is a semiconductor trading company, is 30.1 percent owned by information services company CSK Corp. Game and amusement equipment maker Sega is also 20 percent owned by CSK.
The buyers will buy Lease Electronics shares from Lease Electronics president Koji Kawamoto and four other shareholders, the statement said.
Lease Electronics said the share transfer would strengthen its operations.
